results.detail: TLS certificate verification failed: IP address mismatch. HTTPX proxy path did not preserve the required original-host certificate identity for the IP-pinned URL.

boundary: Read-only public-source diagnostic; no provider call or production mutation. Does not change SSRF guards or prove production transport behavior.
interpretation: One official TDLR page is available through the configured HTTP proxy but inaccessible through the existing secure direct-IP public retriever in this workspace. This demonstrates a local transport limitation, not that the public page or its contacts are absent. It does not prove all 20 recorded timeout outcomes share this cause, nor establish production egress behavior.
preserved_guards: Public-address validation and destination IP pinning
changes: No application transport change was made. TLS verification was not disabled and IP pinning was not removed. Arbitrary untrusted URL retrieval must not be replaced with an unpinned proxy fetch.
remaining_requirement: An execution environment supporting the existing secure direct public-IP transport, or an independently validated proxy transport that preserves destination pinning and original-host TLS verification.
